verdict.rationale: The only mobile-native evidence is an Apple SDK module: RollbarNotifier integrates with Apple Unified Logging to capture telemetry [rollbar-docs-46]. Beyond that there are generic claims of over a dozen supported platforms [rollbar-docs-1] and per-version error tracking [rollbar-docs-6]. Missing for 10: explicit iOS native crash capture, any Android or NDK SDK evidence, documented device/OS context on crash reports, symbolication for native mobile stack traces, and independent corroboration.
